latest_day_count_note: The date-based count can include an advert seen only in an earlier run that day. The latest-run count uses its source-reference run ID.

descriptions.note: Share-control removal is a descriptive length check, not a new cleaned dataset. Completeness is not inferred from length alone.

interpretation.unit: Distinct advert IDs, not independently verified individual positions or unique recruitment episodes.
interpretation.monthly_definition: First successful observation in this dataset. Initial capture is a stock of already-live adverts. Rediscovery of the same ID does not add another first observation.
interpretation.posted_dates: Latest saved advertised date, normalized in memory only; this date can change on editing or re-advertising. It is not a reconstructed original publication series.
interpretation.gap: No scrape ran 1–19 September 2026. Surviving adverts were recovered after restart; adverts removed before restart can be missing. No missing-advert estimate is added to these counts.
interpretation.repeated_text: Different IDs sharing exactly identical stored text. Reposts, multiple positions, rounds and templates can all cause repeats. No records have been deleted or merged.
